billing.faq49Q1: How does the 7-day free trial work?
billing.faq49A1: At checkout you must confirm a bank card via Stripe — it’s required, but nothing is charged for 7 days and you get full access. When the trial ends, €49/mo is charged automatically. Cancel before the 7 days are up and you won’t be charged at all.
billing.faq49Q2: What exactly does the €49/month pay for?
billing.faq49A2: The autopilot shell: trend search and analytics, audience targeting, the UGC studio, the Chrome extension, the Publisher with a content plan, the autopilot and the Gallery. AI generation itself is not included — it runs through your subscriptions (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) or your API keys, and you pay providers directly at their rates.
billing.faq49Q3: Why are subscriptions cheaper than the API?
billing.faq49A3: Providers sell subscription credits much cheaper than the same seconds via API: Veo on a Google AI subscription is 2–10× cheaper, HeyGen avatars about 3× cheaper. And NotebookLM has no public API at all — subscription only. The extension automates the work inside your own accounts, giving you API-like convenience at subscription prices. Exact numbers are in the table and calculator above.
billing.faq49A4: Two are enough to start: Google AI Pro (€21.99/mo — Flow video + NotebookLM with higher limits) and HeyGen Creator ($29/mo — about 30 minutes of Avatar IV). Every service also has free limits (Flow — 50 credits/day, NotebookLM — 3 overviews/day, HeyGen — 3 videos/mo), so you can try the pipeline with no subscriptions at all.
billing.faq49Q5: Can I work with API keys only?
billing.faq49A5: Yes. Connect your keys (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) in Settings and the service generates with them directly, no extension needed. You pay those services at their rates. The routes mix freely: avatars on subscription, voice-over via API, for example.
billing.faq49Q6: How do I cancel? Where is the button?
billing.faq49A6: At the top of this page, in the “Your plan” card, an “Turn off auto-renewal” button appears while a subscription is active. Paid periods aren’t refunded, but access lasts until the period ends. Turn it off during the trial and you won’t be charged at all. You can resume in one click any time before the period ends.
billing.faq49A7: Yes. Enter a promo code above — the discount applies at Premium checkout via Stripe.
billing.disclaimer49: TrendTraffic is not affiliated with Google, HeyGen, ElevenLabs or Blotato. The extension automates work inside your own accounts — follow each provider’s terms of service. Provider prices are quoted from official price lists as of July 2026 and may change.

ttLanding.f1Text: Scan three platforms by niche and geo-region. "Audience targeting": describe your product — AI will automatically fill in the audience, select keywords in 29 languages, and find niches with real demand. Competitor channels in a watchlist with metric history.
ttLanding.f2Text: Paste a link to any TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube video — Gemini will break it down frame by frame: hook, rhythm, structure, captions. The breakdown and subtitles will go into the gallery, and "TrendDNA" will automatically direct your future video.
ttLanding.f2Title: Recipe for virality — frame by frame
ttLanding.f3Text: Four modes: solo, two-person dialogue, your text "as is", direction based on trend analysis. Ready-made HeyGen looks or an avatar from your photo, all ElevenLabs voices including clones, live subtitle styles, and brand kits.
ttLanding.f4Text: Trend monitoring turns findings into ready-made videos based on your template. Auto-publishing chains automatically distribute formats across platforms and slots — TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram receive content on schedule.

ttLanding.pageDescription: TrendTraffic finds viral trends on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, breaks them down frame-by-frame, and assembles UGC videos with AI avatars — with scheduled publishing and AI savings up to 4×.
ttLanding.priceBody: Premium — full access to all modules. First 7 days free, no charges, cancel anytime.
ttLanding.savBody: Our proprietary Chrome extension connects AI services using your existing subscriptions instead of API credit billing. And your own keys (BYOK) — Gemini, ElevenLabs, TikHub, Blotato — work directly, without intermediary markups.
ttLanding.stBody: Trend search, viral video breakdowns, avatars, voiceovers, subtitles, auto-generated videos, and auto-posting—all in one place. Connect your own service keys or subscriptions and pay in the way that's most cost-effective for you.
ttLanding.stat1: cheaper avatar rendering with a subscription
ttLanding.step1Text: Our scanner covers TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube based on your niche, region, and language. Our AI targeter identifies micro-niches and keywords, ranking them by real demand.
ttLanding.step2Text: Gemini analytics breaks down viral videos into hooks, rhythm, and structure. You get the TrendDNA—a recipe for your video studio, plus original subtitles.
ttLanding.step3Text: Our UGC studio creates AI avatar videos: ready-made looks or an avatar from your photo, ElevenLabs voices in 29 languages, cut-ins, subtitles, and a brand kit. Formats 9:16 and 16:9.
ttLanding.step4Text: Autopilot monitors trends and assembles videos using templates, while the Publisher schedules them for 35 days in advance: 9:16 for TikTok, 16:9 for YouTube.
ttLanding.sbB1: AI director auto-arranges speech into panels — you just adjust the storyboard on the filmstrip
ttLanding.sbB2: Three render engines: software (free, no keys), Omni API, or Google Flow with your subscription
ttLanding.sbB3: Flow automation: generation queue runs itself, auto-assembly stitches the finished Reel without you
ttLanding.sbB4: CTA word at the end: viewers comment it — engagement boosts reach
ttLanding.sbBody: Static talking heads get scrolled past in seconds — only changing shots hold attention. Storyboard reassembles your take into a dynamic Reel: transcribes speech, cuts it into phrases up to 8 seconds, and arranges each into panels — close-up speaker, full-screen titles, cutaways, split-screens, mockups, and a call-to-action finale.
ttLanding.sbNote: Included in Premium · "Storyboard" tab in Gallery · finished Reel — directly to Publisher

storyboard.asmIntro: Finished chunks are assembled in order, with a badge on top and (optionally) subtitles. The result goes to Gallery → "Media files" and is ready for the Publisher.
storyboard.chunkOff: Chunk off — will not be included in the video.
storyboard.costNote: The software engine does not use external keys. Transcription — 1 Gemini request; AI panel plan — 1 Claude request (keys in Settings).
storyboard.delMsg: "{{name}}" and its working files will be deleted. The finished video in the Gallery will remain.
storyboard.delPanel: Remove panel (time will go to the adjacent one)
storyboard.empty: No projects yet. Click "New storyboard" and select a talking video (vertical, 15–60 seconds, clear speech).
storyboard.genIntro: Pipeline discipline: chunk 1 first. Check the result — the rest will unlock. The software engine edits by panels: zooms, titles, inserts, split-screen.
storyboard.imgPickNote: A screenshot of statistics, product photo, or graph will appear as an insert/split/mockup for this panel.
storyboard.pickerNote: Talking video: 9:16 vertical, 15–60 seconds, clear speech. TikTok/IG/YouTube links can be downloaded from the "Trends" tab → "By link."
storyboard.pngHint: Visually check: texts are error-free, frames are yours — it's cheaper to catch issues here than after generation.
storyboard.replanHint: Rebuild panels for all chunks with AI director (manual text edits will be overwritten)
storyboard.srcHint: The source changes when creating a project. If you want a different take, create a new storyboard from the Gallery.
storyboard.tabIntro: Auto-edit Reels from talking video: transcribe → storyboard with 6 panels per chunk → render and assemble. Take your take from the Gallery or upload from your device.
storyboard.trChunks: Chunks cut: {{n}} (at phrase ends, up to 8 sec). Next — step 3 "Storyboard."
storyboard.trIntro: Gemini analyzes the entire video: verbatim speech with timestamps + actual scenes. Then the video is cut into chunks up to 8 seconds at phrase ends, and a storyboard is built for each.
storyboard.trNoAiHint: No Gemini key: even 8s chunks, template panels
storyboard.stripHint: Chunk filmstrip. Click a frame to assign it to the selected panel (current: {{n}}). Select a panel by clicking its card or colored stripe.
storyboard.attachNote: Select a clip saved by the extension from Google Flow ("To Gallery"). We will convert it to a chunk format and overlay the original voice.
storyboard.genIntroFlow: Flow engine (semi-auto): download chunk materials, generate in Google Flow (Omni Flash, 9:16, "keep original sound"), save the clip "To Gallery" with the extension — and attach it here. We will overlay the chunk's voice ourselves.
storyboard.genIntroOmni: Omni Flash engine: one generation per chunk — the starting frame "comes alive" according to the panel prompt, with your original voice overlaid. Cost ≈$1/chunk (~10s × $0.10) from your Gemini key. Chunk 1 first!
storyboard.autoAssemble: Auto-assemble video when all chunks are ready
storyboard.flowActiveHint: Flow queue is active — keep the labs.google/…/flow tab open. Statuses update automatically.
storyboard.flowQueueAll: Automatic: send all chunks to Flow
storyboard.genIntroFlow2: Flow engine — AUTOMATIC: open labs.google → Flow in your browser with the TrendTraffic extension and click the button below. The extension will automatically upload the chunk and storyboard, insert the prompt, generate, and return the clip — chunk by chunk, even for a long video (Flow limit ~8s/clip, which is why we cut to 8s). We will overlay the original voice ourselves. Manual mode — buttons on cards.
storyboard.ctaHintV2: Use the same code word in your post caption.
